description: A comedy club with a bare brick wall and dark red curtains. A young woman with long red hair in a black blazer stands on a small stage in a spotlight, holding a microphone and acting out a joke with a straight face. In the audience at small candlelit tables people laugh loudly: a young woman in blue spills her drink and bends over to pick up the glass, and a young man in a cream jumper laughs so hard that he leans forward out of his chair. Glasses and candles stand on the tables.

taps.target: the man in the cream jumper
